# alert-troubleshooter
Observability plumbing (krateo-platformops): a HyperDX alert webhook -> krateo-autopilot A2A
root-cause analysis -> TroubleshootingReport CR (observability.krateo.io/v1alpha1) the portal
renders. It calls an agent; it is not one.

docs/overview.md: architecture
docs/usage.md: install + wire the webhook
docs/configuration.md: image + runtime env
docs/api.md: the two CRDs + HTTP surface
docs/examples.md: runnable examples
docs/release.md: bare-semver build/release
helm/alert-troubleshooter/: the chart
Alert.status.okSince: when the alert last turned OK, unset otherwise; display only.
Alert.spec.apiRef: a RESTAction ({value: N, items?}) polled every interval via snowplow instead of a HyperDX where; needs config.authnUrl.
